description:
`GfxTarget::load_blob` and `LaunchDims` in `crates/gf2-kernels-hip` have no caller. `build.rs` compiles a probe per `kernels/<target>/` directory.

## Background

Comments in `build.rs`, `host/arch.rs` and `host/launch.rs` described both as waiting for per-target kernels and for the launch call sites to be rewired; the issues those comments named are done. The source-comment sweep removed the statements, and this issue tracks the remaining work.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each of `GfxTarget::load_blob` and `LaunchDims` has a production caller covered by a test, or is removed together with the per-target probe build it serves.
- [hard] REQ-02: The crate checks of the `gf2-kernels-hip-ci` gate pass.
title: Adopt or remove the unused HIP blob loader and LaunchDims
